models_evaluated: Lung Cancer Prediction (LCP) radiomics-based CAD tool

links.outcome: Predictive accuracy of Mayo clinical model with vs without AI LCP score
links.effect: AUC 0.58 (Mayo) vs 0.65 (Mayo + LCP); likelihood ratio P = .012; sensitivity 56% vs 38% at 65% threshold; standardized net benefit 18% vs -3.3%
links.quote: At the 65% risk threshold, the Mayo + LCP model was associated with increased sensitivity (56% vs 38%; P = .019), similar false positive rate (33% vs 35%; P = .8), and increased standardized net benefit (18% vs -3.3%) compared with the Mayo model.

screen.reason: Retrospective validation evaluating whether adding a commercially available radiomics AI CAD tool to a clinical prediction model improves pulmonary nodule risk stratification.
